payload.core_composition_summary: Single mechanism: greedy scan after sorting by first map descending, tracking max second-map strength to identify winners.
payload.rationale: Typical solution to this tournament problem is sorting by one map and a greedy pass checking the other map; it reduces to finding non-dominated points, no multiple coordinated mechanisms needed.
